blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Captured human-object interactions provide rich supervision for humanoid loco-manipulation, but they are sparse, heterogeneous, and not directly executable by robots. We introduce InterMimicGen, a self-evolving motion-imitation framework in which robot motion data and a tracking policy improve each other. First, we consolidate motion-captured human-object interaction datasets and retarget them into humanoid robot references while preserving whole-body coordination and dexterous hand-object relationships. This produces a large and diverse humanoid robot reference collection for dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation. Second, we train a physics-based generalist tracker that executes these references in simulation on a humanoid with dexterous hands, covering a scale and diversity beyond prior humanoid tracking systems for loco-manipulation. Third, we close a data flywheel: each round makes small, task-preserving changes to where an interaction takes place and how the body performs it, fine-tunes the tracker on them, and keeps only the variants whose simulated execution completes the task, which seed the next round. With more iterations, these small edits compound into broader coverage around the sparse original demonstrations while preserving task semantics and motion quality. Experiments show contact-preserving retargeting across robot configurations, broad tracking with a single generalist policy, executable motions that keep growing over augmentation rounds, and transfer to real robots. InterMimicGen provides a unified path from heterogeneous human demonstrations to a continually expanding motion resource for humanoid robot learning.
blocks.zh: 被捕获的人体-物体相互作用为人造机器人操纵提供了丰富的监督,但它们是稀有的,种类繁多,不能被机器人直接执行. 我们引入了InterMimicGen,一个自演运动-模拟框架,其中机器人运动数据和跟踪政策相互改进. 首先,我们合并了被捕获的人体物体相互作用数据集,并将其重新定位为人体机器人参考文献,同时保持全身协调和可解的手物体关系. 这产生了一个大型而多样的人类类机器人参考集合,用于去克思特活体全能机能操纵. 第二,我们训练一个基于物理学的通论跟踪器,在使用可变性的手来模拟人形时执行这些参考文献,覆盖了之前人形跟踪系统以外的尺度和多样性,用于loco操纵. 第三,我们关闭一个数据飞轮:每轮对交互发生地和机体如何执行进行小的,任务保全的修改,对上面的跟踪器进行微调,只保留模拟执行完成任务的变体,使下一轮成为种子. 随着更多的迭代,这些小的编辑复合为更宽广的覆盖范围,围绕稀少的原始演示,同时保留了任务语义和运动质量. 实验显示在机器人配置之间保持接触的再瞄准,以单一通论政策进行广泛的跟踪,在增强回合后不断增长的可执行运动,并转移到真正的机器人. InterMimicGen提供了一条统一的道路,从多样的人类演示到不断扩展的人类机器人学习运动资源.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The value of human demonstrations for humanoid loco-manipulation extends beyond reproducing the trajectories they record. Each demonstration captures one coordinated solution in a high-dimensional interaction space, but even a large motion-capture corpus provides sparse samples of this space rather than dense coverage of their feasible variations. Covering these variations therefore requires either a policy that can infer the physically feasible manifold from these sparse samples, or a data-generation process that enriches the data with coordinated, physically valid variations.
blocks.zh: 人类演示对人性活性机能操纵的价值超越了复制他们所记录的轨迹. 每个演示都捕捉出一个高维交互空间中的协调溶液,但即使是一个大型的运动捕捉器,也提供了这个空间的稀有样本,而不是密集地覆盖其可行的变异. 因此,要涵盖这些变化,要么采取一项政策,从这些稀少的样本中推断出物理上可行的多种,要么采用数据生成过程,通过协调的、物理上有效的变化来丰富数据。

blocks.en: A natural route is to train a tracking policy by collecting more references, but any fixed set of references still leaves these variations uncovered. When we look back, generalist trackers already generalize well in locomotion ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , where a motion close to a demonstration usually remains feasible. Loco-manipulation is less forgiving. The robot must hold contact with an object while keeping its balance, so a small change in posture or object placement can break a grasp, push the hand into the object, or make the robot fall. As a result, a tracker that executes a demonstration may still fail on the same task where the trajectory is shifted by only a few centimeters (Sec. 4.4 ). Covering them therefore requires data that grows with the tracker rather than a fixed collection. We build this as a data flywheel , in which executable data and the tracker grow together.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的路线是通过收集更多的参考文献来训练追踪政策,但任何一套固定的参考文献仍然会发现这些变化. 当我们回头看时,通论跟踪器已经在运动中被普遍化了(Luo等,2026年),在那里接近演示的运动通常仍然可行. 洛可操纵更不宽容. 机器人在保持平衡的同时必须保持与物体的接触,因此姿态或物体布置的微小变化会打破抓取,将手推入物体,或使机器人倒下. 因此,执行演示的跟踪器仍然可能在轨迹仅转出几厘米的同一项任务上失败(Sec 4.4)。 因此,要覆盖它们,就需要随着跟踪器而不是固定收集而增加的数据。 我们把它建设成一个数据飞轮, 其中可执行的数据和追踪器一起增长。

blocks.en: To instantiate this flywheel, we introduce InterMimicGen , a self-evolving motion-imitation data engine that couples human-object interaction retargeting, large-scale motion imitation, and iterative data expansion. We first consolidate heterogeneous human-object motion-capture data (Figure 3 ) and retarget the interactions into humanoid robot references. Our retargeter keeps both long-horizon body-object relations and the finger contact that holds small objects: a whole-body solver shapes the grasp to follow the object’s geometry rather than captured finger poses alone, and a fine-grained cleanup then refines the contact at the millimeter scale. The result is a large and diverse robot reference collection for dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation, as shown in Figure InterMimicGen: Scaling Humanoid Loco-Manipulation through Self-Evolving Motion Imitation . Physics-based trackers then execute these references in simulation on a humanoid robot with dexterous hands, and the same trackers later grow together with their reference data through iterative data expansion.
blocks.zh: 为了即时化这个飞轮,我们引入了InterMimicGen, 即一个自演运动-模拟数据引擎, 结合人类-对象交互重定向, 大规模运动模仿, 以及迭代数据扩展。 我们首先整合了各种人类物体运动捕捉数据(图3),并将相互作用重新定位为人体机器人参考。 我们的再瞄准者既保持了长视距的身体-对象关系,又保持了握有小物体的手指接触:一个全身的解析器塑造了能跟随物体几何而非被捕获的手指单独所组成的抓取器,再进行精细的清理,再以毫米尺度来细化接触. 如图InterMimicGen:通过自演运动活化来放大人造Loco-管理。 以物理为基础的跟踪器随后在用可调取的手模拟人造机器人时执行这些引用,而同一种跟踪器后来通过迭代数据扩展与参考数据一起生长.

blocks.en: The goal of this expansion is not to invent new tasks; each human interaction becomes a seed for physically distinct realizations of the same semantic behavior, in the spirit of MimicGen ’s demonstration-driven data expansion ( Mandlekar et al., 2023 ) . We vary object and body motion through small edits around previously validated interactions, such as placing a box farther left or crouching more deeply. Each round fine-tunes the tracker on the current references and edited candidates, executes the candidates in simulation, and retains only rollouts that complete without failure. Drawing on InterMimic ’s insight that a policy can correct imperfect motion by learning from it ( Xu et al., 2025d ) , imitation repairs errors introduced by the edits. The successful rollouts then seed the next round. This feedback is the defining step of Inter Mimic Gen : corrected motions expand the reference set, and the expanded set enables the tracker to realize progressively larger variations.
blocks.zh: 这种扩展的目的不是发明出新的任务;每个人类的相互作用,都成为以MimicGen的示范驱动数据扩展精神(Mandlekar等,2023年)在物理上明显地实现同一语义行为的种子. 我们通过围绕先前验证过的相互作用的小型编辑来改变物体和身体运动,例如把一个盒子放在更左的更远处或更深地蹲下. 每轮对当前参考文献的跟踪器进行微调并编辑出候选人,在模拟中执行候选人,并只保留未失败完成的推出. 依据Intermic的见解, 一项政策可以通过学习来纠正不完美的运动(徐等, 2025d), 成功推出后,下一轮投出种子. 这种回馈是Inter Mimic Gen 的决定性步骤:更正后的动议会扩展参考集,而扩展后的集合可以使跟踪器逐渐实现更大的变化.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. First, we consolidate heterogeneous human-object interaction (HOI) data and retarget them into, to our knowledge, the most diverse humanoid robot reference collection (see Sec. 4.1 ) for dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation. Second, using these references, we train a physics-based generalist tracker that realizes this repertoire on a target embodiment at a scale beyond prior humanoid tracking systems ( Weng et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026b ) for loco-manipulation. Third, we introduce a self-evolving augmentation-learning loop that expands this repertoire through coupled variations in object and whole-body motions, turning validated interactions into a growing resource for subsequent learning of whole-body controllers.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 首先,我们合并了各种人类-物体相互作用数据,并根据我们的知识,把它们重新定位为最多样化的人体机器人参考集合(见Sec 4.1),用于解开全身的机能操纵. 其次,我们利用这些参考材料,培训一个基于物理学的通论跟踪器,以超越以往人造物跟踪系统的规模,在目标中实现这种再现(Weng等人,2025年;Yang等人,2026年;He等人,2026年;Cao等人,2026年b),用于loco操纵。 第三,我们引入了自演增强-学习回路,通过物体和全身运动的相交变化来扩展这种回路,把经过验证的相互作用变成后来学习全身控制器的不断增长的资源.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Human-object interaction data. Human-object and human-scene capture datasets provide complementary interaction references across whole-body grasping, object tracking, bimanual manipulation, and scene-level coordination ( Taheri et al., 2020 ; Bhatnagar et al., 2022 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Lv et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2023 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2023a ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ) . These resources differ in object diversity, contact structure, and body and hand annotation, shaping the supervision available for imitation. Among them, InterAct ( Xu et al., 2025c ) consolidates heterogeneous interaction sources, while HiPHI ( Ji et al., 2026 ) adds extensive body-object capture. We combine their motion into a robot reference collection and expand physically executable coverage through retargeting and humanoid robot execution in simulation.
blocks.zh: 人与对象交互数据. 人体-物体和人体-场景捕捉数据集为全体取取取、物体跟踪、双人操纵和场景协调提供了互补的相互作用参考(Taheri等,2020年;Bhatnagar等,2022年;Huang等,2024年;Lv等,2024年;Fan等,2023年;Lu等,2025年;张等,2025年;刘等,2025年b;张等,2023年a;赵等,2024年;李等,2023年). 这些资源在物体多样性、联系结构、身体和手笔方面各不相同,形成了可供模仿的监督。 其中,InterAct(Xu等,2025c)整合了多种相互作用源,而HiPHI(Ji等,2026)则会增加广泛的体-物捕捉. 我们把他们的运动合并成一个机器人参考集合,并通过模拟中的再瞄准和人造机器人执行来扩大物理可执行的覆盖范围.

blocks.en: Whole-body and dexterous motion retargeting. Motion retargeting adapts demonstrations across morphologies using learned mappings or optimization objectives built from skeleton structure, contact cues, and geometric correspondences ( Villegas et al., 2018 ; Aberman et al., 2020 ; Villegas et al., 2021 ; Reda et al., 2023 ; Araújo et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2026a ) . For interaction, the relationships between body, object, hand, and scene must survive the change in embodiment rather than only the joint trajectory ( Kim et al., 2016 ; Zhang et al., 2023b ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Dexterous teleoperation and synthesis study high-quality hand or hand-arm transfer ( Handa et al., 2020 ; Qin et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025b ) , but whole-body interaction also requires those contacts to remain consistent with locomotion and balance. Our retargeter therefore separates the problem into a coarse whole-body interaction solve and a local dense contact refinement, so hand motion is improved without disturbing the body-object motion.
blocks.zh: 全身而去的动作重定向. 运动重定目标可以运用从骨架结构、接触提示和几何对应物中构建的已学习到的绘图或优化目标来适应整个形态的演示(Villegas等,2018;Aberman等,2020;Villegas等,2021;Reda等,2023;Araújo等,2025;Cao等,2026a). 对于相互作用,身体,物体,手和场景之间的关系必须活过浮出水面的变化,而不只是联合出轨(金等,2016;张等,2023b;杨等,2026. Dexterous远程操作和合成研究高质量手或手臂转移(Handa等,2020年;秦等,2023年;赵等,2026年;潘等,2025年;徐等,2025年b),但全身交互也要求这些接触保持运动和平衡. 因此,我们的再瞄准器将问题分离成粗糙的全身相互作用解决方案和局部密集的接触改进,因此手动得到改进而不会扰动身体-物体运动.

blocks.en: Physics-based imitation and whole-body manipulation. Physics-based imitation began with example-guided control of individual skills ( Peng et al., 2018 ) and later scaled to shared controllers over diverse motion libraries ( Won et al., 2020 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) . On physical humanoids, teleoperation and imitation enable whole-body control ( He et al., 2024 ; Ze et al., 2025 ) , while universal tracking policies and visuomotor extensions broaden the motion and sensing interfaces ( Yin et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Ding et al., 2025 ) . Object-centric extensions couple body and object dynamics for grasping and dynamic skills ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Tessler et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025d ; Xu et al., 2026a ) , and then move to real-world humanoid loco-manipulation ( Weng et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Dao et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Kalaria et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2026 ) . Our work starts from reference tracking and extends it into a self-evolving data engine, with real deployment.
blocks.zh: 以物理为基础的模仿和全身操纵. 以物理为主的仿真开始由以实例指导的个人技能控制(Peng等,2018年),后被缩放为多功能运动库的共享控制器(Won等,2020;Roo等,2023年). 在物理人相上,远程操作和仿真使全身控制成为可能(He等,2024;Ze等,2025;而通用跟踪政策和粘接器扩展则拓宽了运动和感知界面(Yin等,2026;Luo等,2026;Ding等,2025)。 以物体为中心的对接机体和物体动力学用于把握和动态技能(Wang等,2023;Luo等,2024;Wang等,2025b;Tessler等,2025;Xu等,2025d;Xu等,2026a),然后转向现实世界人机操纵(Weng等,2025;赵等,2025;Fu等,2026;Liu等,2025a;Dao等,2024;Sun等,2025;Kalaria等,2025;Yin等,2025;Wang等,2025a;Hu等,2026等). 我们的工作从参考跟踪开始,并扩展至一个自我演变的数据引擎,并进行真正的部署。

blocks.en: Demonstration augmentation and iterative generation. A demonstration can be reused beyond its recorded trajectory ( Mandlekar et al., 2023 ) : collected segments preserve task intent, while execution under adapted conditions becomes valid training data. Later systems extend this execution-validated reuse to bimanual dexterity ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , skill composition ( Garrett et al., 2024 ) , intervention-driven data collection ( Hoque et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) , policy self-improvement ( Bousmalis et al., 2024 ) , and humanoid loco-manipulation ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . A related line in character and humanoid control scales policies through generated experience or closed-loop motion generation ( Xu et al., 2025a ; Debbad et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Our setting differs in both domain and mechanism: we expand dexterous and agile humanoid loco-manipulation from motion-capture references, and we self-evolve through motion imitation itself instead of a separate kinematic motion synthesizer, which is often brittle for object interaction.
blocks.zh: 示范增强和迭代生成。 示范可以超越其记录的轨迹加以再利用(Mandlekar等,2023年) :所收集的片段保留了任务意图,而根据调整后的条件执行则成为有效的培训数据. 后来的系统将这种经执行验证的再利用扩展到了双体分解(Jiang等,2025年),技能构成(Garrett等,2024年),干预驱动的数据收集(Hoque等,2024年;Luo等,2025年),政策自我改进(Bousmalis等,2024年),以及人造自控(Lin等,2026年). 通过生成的经验或闭路运动生成,在性能和人造物控制尺度政策上的相关线条(徐等,2025a;德布巴德等,2026;徐等,2026b;王等,2026.). 我们的设定在域和机理上都有所不同:我们从运动-抓取的参考文献中扩展出可变而敏捷的人体活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: InterMimicGen turns captured human-object interactions into an expanding collection of robot references that a physics-based tracker can execute (Figure 2 ). A reference 𝝃 \boldsymbol{\xi} stores the target robot motion, object motion, and contact intent of one clip. We first consolidate heterogeneous captures (Sec. 3.1 ) and retarget them to robot embodiments (Sec. 3.2 ). A generalist tracker then realizes these references under robot dynamics (Sec. 3.3 ). Finally, self-evolving motion imitation edits how verified interactions are realized and keeps only the edits that the tracker executes in physics. Repeating this over rounds, with a tracker that keeps learning from the new motions, lets the verified references and the tracker grow together (Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: InterMimicGen将所捕获到的人类-物体相互作用转化为一个基于物理学的跟踪器可以执行的不断扩展的机器人参考集合(图2. 引用\\ boldsymbol\xi}存储目标机器人运动,物体运动,以及一个片段的接触意图. 我们首先合并了各种捕获(第3.1节),并将其重新瞄准机器人的化身(第3.2节)。 一个通俗主义的追踪器随后在机器人动力学(Sec.3.3.)下实现这些引用. 最后,自演运动模仿会编辑如何实现已核实的相互作用,并只保留追踪器在物理中执行的编辑. 用一个不断从新的运动中学习的追踪器,让经过核实的参考文献和追踪器一起成长(Sec.3.4.).

blocks.en: 3.1 A consolidated interaction reference collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 综合互动参考文献集

blocks.en: Because our learning loop expands skills already represented in the source motions, the seed collection should cover interaction semantics as broadly as possible. We combine InterAct ( Xu et al., 2025c ) and the object-interaction portion of HiPHI ( Ji et al., 2026 ) into a shared collection. InterAct contributes diverse tasks and object categories by consolidating public motion-capture datasets ( Taheri et al., 2020 ; Bhatnagar et al., 2022 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2023a ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ) , while HiPHI contributes longer synchronized human-object motions. Figure 3 summarizes this complementarity: the sources occupy different distributions of human motion, object geometry, and interaction space, and their union improves coverage on external motion probes. We convert both sources to a common body-object-hand representation and treat absent hand annotations as unknown rather than as evidence of no contact, and later refine the hand with retargeting.
blocks.zh: 因为我们的学习循环扩展了源运动中已经表现出来的技能,种子收集应尽可能广泛地涵盖互动语义. 我们把InterAct(徐等,2025c.)和HiPHI(Ji等,2026.)的物体交互部分合并为共享集合. InterAct通过整合公共运动-抓取数据集(Taheri等,2020;Bhatnagar等,2022;Huang等,2024;Zhang等,2023a;Zhao等,2024;Li等,2023;)来贡献不同的任务和对象类别,而HIPHI则贡献更长的同步人类对象运动. 图3总结了这种互补性:来源占据了人类运动,物体几何和相互作用空间的不同分布,它们的结合提高了外在运动探测器的覆盖范围. 我们把这两种来源都转换成共同的体-物-物的表示,并将缺失的手说明视为未知而非没有接触的证据,然后通过重新瞄准来改进手.

blocks.en: We then keep only the interactions each target robot can physically support. Sequences that simulation cannot represent, such as bag hanging with an unmodeled strap, are removed, and platforms without dexterous hands exclude interactions whose success depends on articulated finger contact. The resulting references share one format for downstream training (Sec. A ).
blocks.zh: 然后我们只保留每个目标机器人 能够支持的相互作用 模拟所不能代表的序列,如用未建模的带子挂起的包被去除,没有可调谐的手的平台排除了其成功取决于清晰的指相接触的相互作用. 由此产生的参考资料与下游培训有一个格式(Sec.A)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Retargeting for dexterous whole-body interaction
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 重新瞄准用于自相矛盾的全身交互

blocks.en: Retargeting must satisfy constraints at two scales. The whole body must preserve support and body-object geometry over long horizons, while the hand must resolve millimeter-scale contact around small object regions. Optimizing both with one objective tends to loosen contact or over-constrain the body. We therefore solve the whole body first, with a finger-opposition term that shapes the grasp, and then remove local artifacts in a cleanup that preserves contact (Algorithm 1 ).
blocks.zh: 重新确定目标必须满足两个尺度上的限制。 整个身体必须在长地平线上保持支持和身体-物体几何,而手必须解决小地平面周围的毫米相接问题. 以一个目标优化两者往往会放松接触或过度约束身体. 因此,我们首先解决了整个身体,用一个指对名词来塑造抓取,然后在保存接触的清理中去掉当地文物(Agorithm 1 .

blocks.en: Interaction-preserving whole-body retargeting. The coarse stage transfers body-object relationships through an interaction mesh ( Yang et al., 2026 ) that connects sparse body landmarks with sampled object geometry, so matching the mesh preserves spatial interaction structure rather than only joint poses. It solves for the floating base and articulated body under the target robot’s constraints, with sparse hand landmarks placing the wrists and palms. Because different motion clips might fail under different local constraints, we use several constrained solvers in turn and keep the first feasible solution. The solve keeps the source object trajectory fixed and includes the finger-opposition term below, so the hands close around the object while the body is solved.
blocks.zh: 保持互动 整个身体 重新定位。 粗相相会通过相互作用网(Yang等,2026年)来转移体-对象关系,将稀有的体地标与被采样的物体几何相接,因此将网能相匹配可以保存空间相互作用结构,而不只是联想. 它解决了被目标机器人限制下被漂浮的地基和被分解出的身体,手迹稀少地将手腕和手掌放入地上. 由于不同的运动片段在不同的局部限制下可能失败,我们依次使用几个受制约的解析器,并保留第一个可行的解析方案. 解法将源对象轨迹固定,并包含下方的指对名词,因此手在解体时会紧紧地围绕对象.

blocks.en: Geometry cleanup with contact preservation. The whole-body solve can still leave small penetrations, jitter, and contact drift. We therefore refine the robot and object trajectories with two successive Adam passes ( Kingma and Ba, 2015 ) . The first reduces robot-object, floor, and hand self-collision while regularizing deviation from the coarse motion, foot support, joint limits, and temporal smoothness. The second smooths the repaired trajectory under collision constraints and preserves hand-object relationships during contact. Each pass is retained only if its output satisfies deviation and quality checks relative to its input. Robots without articulated fingers omit finger-specific terms. Sec. B gives the objectives, acceptance checks, and solver settings.
blocks.zh: 几何清理与接触保护. 全身溶解仍然可以留下小的穿透,焦躁,并接触漂流. 因此,我们通过连续两次亚当出道(Kingma和Ba,2015年)来完善机器人和物体轨迹。 第一种会减少机器人-物体,地板,和手自相折射,同时将从粗运动的偏差,脚支支持,关节限制,以及时间平滑等常规化. 第二道在相撞限制下平滑已修复的轨迹,并保持接触时的手-物体关系. 每张通行证只有在其产出满足了偏差和与输入相比的质量检查的情况下才予以保留。 没有发音指的机器人省略了指特指名词. 师曰. B给出目标,接受检查,以及解析器设置.

blocks.en: 3.3 A generalist for interaction motion imitation
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 模拟交互运动的通论家

blocks.en: The generalist tracker turns kinematic references into physically executable motions, and later serves as the validator of augmented references. It observes the robot state, upcoming reference frames, and object-relative geometry, including distance-decayed vectors from each body link to its nearest point on the object surface. It outputs joint targets for proportional-derivative (PD) control, and on the Inspire hands, coupled finger joints follow their driving joints through mimic-joint constraints instead of acting as independent actuators. We train a single policy π θ \pi_{\theta} with proximal policy optimization ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) across parallel environments, sharing parameters across motions and objects. The reward balances body motion, object motion, interaction geometry, and contact fidelity. Reference-state initialization exposes different phases of long sequences, and adaptive sampling emphasizes difficult motions. More details are presented in Sec. C .
blocks.zh: 通用追踪器将动能参考转化为实体可执行动议,后作为扩充参考的验证器. 它观测到机器人状态,即将到来的参考框架,和与物体相适应的几何,包括从每个身体链接到物体表面最接近的点的相距去向量. 它为比例-衍生(PD)控制提供联合目标,在Inspire手上,相接的指关节通过模仿-联合制约来跟踪其驱动关节,而不是作为独立的起动器. 我们通过平行环境,在运动和物体之间共享参数,开展一项单一政策,并优化近期政策(Schulman等,2017年)。 奖励平衡了身体运动,物体运动,相互作用几何,以及接触忠诚. 参考状态初始化暴露出长序的不同阶段,适应性取样强调困难的运动. 详情见Sec.C.。

blocks.en: 3.4 Self-evolving motion imitation
blocks.zh: 3.4 自演运动模仿

blocks.en: A human capture shows what an interaction achieves but only one way of performing it. We therefore generate new ways of performing the same interaction. This follows the spirit of MimicGen ( Mandlekar et al., 2023 ) , which turns one demonstration into many training examples by replaying it under new conditions and keeping the successful replays, and here the replay is motion imitation by our tracker. Each variant is derived from a verified parent reference 𝝃 \boldsymbol{\xi} and must keep four properties of the parent, which form the invariant set ℐ \mathcal{I} : the interaction type, the intended contacts, the object, and the task outcome. Variants thus add new motions around each capture without changing its meaning.

A proposal that fails is never edited again, so errors cannot accumulate across rounds. Each round picks a diverse set of the successful motions that reached farthest from their seed and moves each a fixed step further (Sec. D.5 ). Coverage is measured independently of these edit coordinates (Sec. F.4 ).

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate four questions. ( i ) Can one retargeter preserve both long-horizon body-object relations and fine finger contact, and does this yield cleaner references than prior retargeters (Sec. 4.2 )? ( ii ) How broadly can trackers execute these references across objects and embodiments, and which interactions remain hard (Sec. 4.3 )? ( iii ) Does growing the data together with the tracker expand what it can execute beyond the original references, and does this growth come from learning rather than from filtering more rollouts (Sec. 4.4 )? ( iv ) Do the resulting motions carry over from simulation to different real humanoid robots (Sec. 4.5 )?
blocks.zh: 我们评价四个问题。 (一. ) (中文(简体) ). 重新瞄准者能否既保持长相物体关系又保持精细的手指接触,这是否比以前的重新瞄准者(第4.2条)更能提供更干净的参考? (二) 国家 追踪者如何广泛地在物体和表象之间执行这些参考,哪些相互作用仍然很困难(第4.3节)? (三) 数据与跟踪器一起增长是否扩展了它能够执行的超出原始引用的内容,这种增长是否来自学习而不是过滤更多的推广(第4.4节)? 页:1 由此产生的运动是否从模拟转移到不同的真人机器人(第4.5节)?

blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: Data and embodiments. We consolidate InterAct ( Xu et al., 2025c ) and HiPHI ( Ji et al., 2026 ) into a collection of 16,059 motions, 140.68 reference hours, and 157 object entries (Table 4 ), which covers a wide range of everyday interactions (Figure 3 ). We retarget it to six robot configurations: G1 ( Unitree Robotics, ) with non-dexterous, Inspire ( Inspire Robots, ) , or Dex3 ( Unitree Robotics, ) hands, Booster T1 and K1 ( Booster Robotics, ; Booster Robotics, ) , and Dexmate Vega ( Dexmate, ) . Sec. A.1 details which experiments run on each embodiment.

blocks.en: Metrics. Each experiment uses its own group of metrics, and Sec. E defines each of them once. Retargeted references are scored on plausibility and fidelity to the human motion: hand-contact preservation, in-hand slip, penetration, foot sliding, MPJPE, and joint acceleration. Tracking is scored by the success rate, the fraction of clips executed to the end without a fall or a large body, object, or interaction error, and by body and object errors on successful clips. For the augmentation loop, we report the growth of the verified reference set, the success of the tracker before and after self-evolution on the generated and original references, and the quality of their executions.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 每一个实验都使用自己的一组度量衡,而Sec. E定义了每一个度量衡一次. 重新定向的参考被评为人运动的可信性和忠诚性:手相接性保存,手相接滑动,穿入,脚相接滑动,MPJPE,和联合加速. 追踪通过成功率,没有掉入或大体,对象,或相互作用出错的情况下被执行到结尾的片段,以及成功片段上被执行的正体和对象出错来得分. 关于增量循环,我们报告经核实的参考文献集的增长、自演前后追踪器在生成的参考文献和原始参考文献上的成功以及处决的质量。

blocks.en: Baselines. For dexterous retargeting, we compare with Weave ( Cao et al., 2026b ) , whose released retargeted references use the same embodiment with InterMimicGen. For retargeting without dexterous hands, we compare with OmniRetarget ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , UMR ( Cao et al., 2026a ) , and ULTRA ( He et al., 2026 ) on G1. blocks.en: 4.2 Retargeting quality and dexterous contact
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 重新瞄准质量和离心接触

blocks.en: Our retargeter produces cleaner dexterous references. Table 1 compares our retargeting with Weave on G1 with Inspire hands. Our references keep hand contact slightly better, greatly reduce object penetration, foot sliding, and joint acceleration, and stay closer to the raw motion, at the cost of slightly higher in-hand slip. We attribute this to explicitly shaping the grasp and then additionally refining contact in a second cleanup, so better hands do not come at the cost of the body.

blocks.en: 4.4 Does iterative generation expand learned competence?
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 迭代是否扩大了学习能力?

blocks.en: We run five rounds of self-evolving motion imitation on bimanual and grasping interactions with G1 and Inspire hands, and on bimanual interactions with G1 and Dex3 hands, grouped from the successful rollouts in the tracking benchmark (Sec. 4.3 ). Each round applies object edits, which move and turn where the object is placed relative to the seed’s own execution, and body edits, which change the posture that realizes the interaction; later rounds edit only references verified in earlier rounds. We ask three questions: are the augmented references of good quality, does each round expand their range, and does training on them improve the tracker?
blocks.zh: 我们运行了五轮自演运动仿制,分别是双手和抓取与G1和Inspire手的相互作用,以及双手和G1和Dex3手的相互作用,从跟踪基准的成功推出(第4.3节)中归结而来。 每回合应用对象编辑,相对于种子自身执行的位置移动并转出位置,而身体编辑则改变实现交互的姿态;后回合只编辑在前回合被核实的引用. 我们问了三个问题:质量是否提高,每轮是否扩大范围,有关培训是否改善跟踪仪?

blocks.en: Augmented references stay close to the originals in quality. Averaged over all rounds, executions of augmented references stay close to those of the original references in body joint acceleration and hand jitter, while foot sliding rises from about 1% to about 2% of contact frames (quality columns of Table 3 ). All three measures rise moderately in later rounds, which by design accept edits farther from the captures (Sec. F.3 ).

blocks.en: Each round expands the set of executable references. Every setting keeps accepting new spatial and body references: the verified reference set grows about twentyfold in the first round and more than a hundredfold by the fifth (growth column of Table 3 , Figures 6 and 8 ; per-round values in Sec. F.3 ). Body edits also widen the range along another axis, posture: their references spread over a region of body motion several times wider than the scene-scaling variants of ULTRA ( He et al., 2026 ) (Sec. F.4 ). This expansion depends on learning. A frozen tracker that only filters candidates accepts almost none of the new candidates after the first round, because the new candidates start from first-round successes that already lie beyond its reach (Sec. F.2 ).
blocks.zh: 每轮扩展一组可执行引用. 每个设定都不断接受新的空间和身体参考:经核实的参考集合在第一轮中增长了约20倍,到第五轮则增长了100多倍(表3的增长一栏,图6和图8;每轮数值在Sec.F.3中)。 身体编辑还沿着另一个轴,姿势来拓宽范围:其参考文献分布在一个身体运动区域,比ULTRA的场景缩放变体(He等,2026年)(sec.F.4. 这种扩张取决于学习. 一个只过滤候选人的被冻结追踪器在第一轮之后几乎不接受任何新候选人,因为新候选人是从已经无法达到的第一轮成功开始的(Sec.F.2.)。

blocks.en: Self-evolution makes the tracker better. We replay every accepted reference and every original reference with the tracker before and after self-evolution, counting a reference as executed when at least one of three rollouts reaches its end (success columns of Table 3 ). The original tracker fails on more than a third of the accepted references even though it is trained with large-scale data, whereas the evolved tracker executes nearly all of them, and both execute every original reference. Self-evolution therefore extends what the tracker can execute without losing what it could already do.
blocks.zh: 自我进取让跟踪者更好. 我们与自演化前后的追踪者重放每一个公认的引用和每一个原始引用,在三次推出中至少有一次达到尾声时计算出一个已执行的引用(表3成功列). 最初的追踪器在被接受的参考文献中,有超过三分之一的参考文献上失败了,尽管它受过大规模数据的培训,而已进化的追踪器则几乎全部执行,两者都执行每一个原始参考文献. 因此,自我演进扩展了追踪者可以执行的,而不会失去它已经能够完成的.

blocks.en: 4.5 Cross-embodiment execution and real-world transfer
blocks.zh: 4.5 交叉执行和现实世界移交

blocks.en: To verify that the trajectories produced by InterMimicGen work beyond simulation, we execute them on real robots. Each embodiment uses the parts of the framework it supports (Sec. A.1 ), and each platform runs its own low-level controller, trained by us or publicly available (Sec. G ). These controllers are blind to the object and track only the robot motion, yet our trajectories execute well on every platform, suggesting that they are physically consistent enough to transfer without object feedback. Figure 7 shows box lifting and placement, suitcase pulling, tripod carrying, and chair relocation, with more videos on the project page .

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: InterMimicGen treats a humanoid tracker as both a consumer and a producer of interaction data. A consolidated human-object motion collection supplies diverse task semantics, hand-aware retargeting transfers them to six robot configurations, and physics-based tracking grounds them in executable motion. The evolving loop then turns validated variations into new references. Every round enlarges the archive, and the fine-tuned tracker learns interactions beyond the base tracker’s reach while keeping its seed skills. Learning is what keeps the loop going, since a frozen tracker stops accepting new variations after the first round. Acknowledgments. We thank Ziyin Wang for helping with the on-site deployment.
blocks.zh: InterMimicGen将人造物追踪器既作为消费者,又作为交互数据的生产者. 人体-物体运动集集提供了多种任务语义,手感再瞄准它们转移到了6个机器人配置,以物理为基础的跟踪将其置于可执行运动中. 然后,不断演变的循环将经验证的变异变成新的参考。 每一回合都扩大档案,经过微调的追踪者在保持种子技能的同时,学习基础追踪者所无法达到的互动。 学习是使循环持续的因素,因为被冻结的跟踪器在第一轮之后不再接受新的变化. 释名相. 感谢王子仁协助现场部署.

blocks.en: Interaction-preserving whole-body solve. The whole-body stage transfers body-object structure, rather than joint poses alone, from the scaled human reference to the robot. It builds an interaction mesh over body landmarks and sampled object geometry and minimizes E coarse = λ I ​ E interaction + λ C ​ E cover + E temporal + E posture , E_{\mathrm{coarse}}=\lambda_{I}E_{\mathrm{interaction}}+\lambda_{C}E_{\mathrm{cover}}+E_{\mathrm{temporal}}+E_{\mathrm{posture}}, (4) subject to joint, support, and collision constraints, with the object trajectory fixed. The interaction term E interaction E_{\mathrm{interaction}} matches the Laplacian coordinates of the robot-object mesh to the scaled source interaction ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , while the temporal and posture terms regularize frame-to-frame motion and keep the posture plausible. We set λ I = 10 \lambda_{I}=10 , uniform over the mesh vertices. E temporal E_{\mathrm{temporal}} penalizes the squared change of each coordinate of 𝒒 t \boldsymbol{q}_{t} from the previous frame’s solution, with weight 2 for the floating base, legs, and waist and 1 for the arm and finger joints. E posture E_{\mathrm{posture}} penalizes the waist yaw and roll angles with weight 0.2 each. blocks.en: Geometry cleanup with contact preservation. The whole-body solution can still leave millimeter-scale penetration and jitter. The cleanup optimizes the robot joints, the floating base, and small object-pose corrections with two successive Adam passes, each followed by projection onto joint limits. blocks.en: Acceptance checks. Each pass accepts a candidate only after the complete trajectory passes its check against that pass’s input: the repair check compares with the whole-body solution, and the smoothing check compares with the repaired trajectory (Table 7 ). The checks bound how far the root, joints, object, and body may move, how much penetration may grow, and how many contact frames must survive, which applies when the input has at least five. Repair must also improve penetration: if the input’s maximum penetration exceeds 3 mm, the output must reach at most 3 mm or cut that maximum by at least 25%. Smoothing must not worsen the aggregate jerk score. Jerk limits allow each metric to grow by the listed factor plus a small fixed margin. Both checks reject nonfinite results, quaternion-norm errors of at least 10 − 6 10^{-6} , new joint-limit violations, and objects that sink more than 5 mm below their starting height or the floor.

blocks.en: Retargeting to wheeled robots. For wheeled embodiments such as the Dexmate Vega, we keep the interaction-mesh objective and adapt the configuration space and landmark correspondences. The planar base translation and yaw are optimized jointly with the upper body, while the chassis height stays at its nominal value and the base roll and pitch are fixed at zero. Human leg and foot landmarks are removed from the interaction mesh and the foot-contact constraints are disabled, so the base, torso, and arms together preserve the demonstrated manipulation without passing changes in human pelvis height to the chassis. The three torso joints are constrained only through the mapped shoulder, elbow, wrist, and hand landmarks rather than by matching human spine angles. Temporal regularization and bounds on frame-to-frame changes of the upper-body joints and the planar base limit abrupt motion, and the wheel joints stay fixed during this kinematic stage. We discuss how the trajectories can be used by the real controller in Sec. G .

blocks.en: Augmentation edits a verified reference in interaction coordinates, and the loop keeps only edits that pass physical execution (Sec. 3.4 ). blocks.en: D.1 Edit space and invariants

blocks.en: Edits broaden how each task is physically realized, while its manipulation semantics remain those of the source capture. The edit 𝒛 = ( 𝒛 task , 𝒛 body ) \boldsymbol{z}=(\boldsymbol{z}^{\mathrm{task}},\boldsymbol{z}^{\mathrm{body}}) of Eq. 2 combines spatial coordinates, the object translation and yaw in the seed’s interaction frame, with body coordinates that change the pelvis, the stance and toe angle, or the elbow posture. Every edited reference keeps the invariant set ℐ \mathcal{I} of its parent: the interaction type, the intended contacts, the object, and the task outcome. Body edits also keep the object path, palm targets, and relevant support constraints of the parent, and a zero edit reproduces the parent. Each edit is blended in gradually over the interaction through a weight α t \alpha_{t} , after which the edited reference recomputes its forward kinematics and velocities and its body-object interaction features from the edited geometry (Figure 6 ).

blocks.en: Body edits vary the robot’s posture around a fixed task, and each of their three types keeps its own set of quantities fixed. Pelvis edits change the pelvis and torso configuration, namely crouch, translation, and orientation, and keep the object path, palms, ankle targets, and contact intent. Stance edits change foot separation and toe orientation and keep the root, arms, fingers, object path, and contact intent. Arm edits use the extra freedom of each seven-DoF arm and keep the palms, object, root, legs, fingers, and contact intent. Each edit is blended in and out smoothly around the interaction before the validity checks of Sec. D.4 .
blocks.zh: 身体编辑会围绕固定任务来改变机器人的姿势,它们三种类型中的每一种都保持自己的一组数量固定. Pelvis编辑更改了骨盆和躯干配置,即蹲下,翻译,取向,并保留对象路径,掌上,脚踝目标,以及联系意图. Stance编辑会改变脚分和脚趾取向,并保持根,臂,指,物体路径,以及接触意图. 臂部编辑使用每个七指臂的额外自由度,并保持手掌,物体,根,腿,指,和接触意图. 每一个编辑在Sec.D.4.的有效性检查之前,在交互作用周围顺利地混合。

blocks.en: Object and body edits share the acceptance principle of Sec. 3.4 , but differ in when the tracker learns them (Table 9 ). Before physics, a candidate is checked only for basic validity. Object candidates, with near-duplicates removed, then join fine-tuning before they are judged. Body candidates are judged with the current tracker and join training in later rounds once verified. Each candidate is executed with three rollouts under different random seeds.

blocks.en: Criteria. Terminal hand contact holds when the simulated hand contacts match the reference contact labels in six of the final ten frames. A sustained fall is a collapsed or strongly misoriented pose that lasts ten consecutive frames or six of the final ten. Smoothness compares the high-frequency motion of the hands and body, above 6 Hz, with that of the original source and of the other candidates, and rejects clear outliers. A placed object must rest stably on its support in six of the final ten frames. These checks preserve the type of outcome rather than the exact target pose.
blocks.zh: 标准。 当模拟的手接头与最后十帧中的六帧中的参考接头标签相匹配时,终端手接头会保持. 持续倒塌是一种倒塌或强烈地被误导的姿势,持续了10个连续帧或最后10个中的6个. 平滑性将6Hz以上的手和身体的高频运动与原始来源和其他候选人的运动相提并论,并拒绝明显的出局. 一个被放置的物体必须在最后的10个框架的6个中,被稳定地停留在它的支撑上. 这些检查保留了结果的类型,而不是确切的目标。

blocks.en: D.5 Growth over rounds

blocks.en: New edits are proposed only around verified parents, so each round starts where the previous one succeeded. For object edits, each task selects up to 16 parents among the successful edits that reached farthest from their seed, favoring distinct sources and reliable execution, and gives each 16 edits that move further outward. For body edits, each source’s successful rollouts are described by their achieved posture, and the most extreme successful postures receive the outward edits of Sec. D.3 . Figure 8 shows nine further captures.
blocks.zh: 新的编辑建议只围绕已验证的家长进行,因此每回合从上一轮成功的地方开始. 对于对象编辑,每个任务在离其种子最远的成功编辑中选择最多16个家长,偏好不同的源和可靠的执行,并给每个16个进一步向外移动的编辑. 对于身体编辑,每个来源的成功推出都用其已实现的姿态来描述,而最极端的成功态势则得到Sec.D.3的外向编辑. 图8显示还有9个记录。

blocks.en: This section defines each metric of Sec. 4.1 once, grouped in the order of the experiments: data coverage (Figure 3 ), retargeted references (Sec. 4.2 ), tracking (Sec. 4.3 ), and the augmentation loop (Sec. 4.4 ). All compared methods share the same features, thresholds, and frame rates.

blocks.en: E.1 Data coverage
blocks.zh: E.1 联合国 数据覆盖面

blocks.en: The panels of Figure 2 and Figure 3 are computed from the following features.
blocks.zh: 图2和图3的小组是根据以下特征计算的。

blocks.en: Human motion. Each sequence is described by 21 non-finger joint positions relative to the pelvis, normalized by skeletal height, plus root displacement, height, and heading. Each channel is resampled to 128 frames and truncated to its first 16 DCT coefficients (1,088 dimensions), and PCA-64 then UMAP-2 gives one point per sequence (16,059). The feature uses no object information.
blocks.zh: 人类运动。 每个序列由相对于骨盆的21个非指相接位置来描述,由骨骼高,加上根移位,高,和取向而正常化. 每个通道被重印到128帧并被切换到其前16个DCT系数(1,088维),而PA-64再后UMAP-2给出了每个序列一分(16,059分). 该特性没有使用对象信息.

blocks.en: Object geometry. Each mesh is sampled with 10,000 surface points, centered, scaled to the unit sphere, and oriented by its first source pose, then embedded with a frozen OpenShape PointBERT encoder; embeddings are averaged over four yaw rotations. PCA and UMAP give one point per distinct geometry (155). Unit-sphere scaling removes physical size.
blocks.zh: 对象几何. 每个网格被抽取出一万个表面点,以中心为中心,缩放到单位球体上,并被取材于其第一个出源姿势取向,再用被冻结的OpenShape PointBERT编码器嵌入;嵌入平均在四个yaw自转上. 五氯苯甲醚和UMAP每个不同的几何学给出一分(155分)。 单位相圈缩放可去除物理大小.

blocks.en: Human-object interaction. The feature concatenates the object position relative to the pelvis, the wrist positions and surface distances relative to the object, the wrist separation, and the object height, translation, and rotation, encoded with the same DCT scheme. Each block is normalized separately before PCA-64 and UMAP-2.
blocks.zh: 人与物相互作用. 特征将对象相对于骨盆的位置,相对于对象的手腕位置和表面距离,手腕分离,以及对象的高度,翻译,和旋转,用相同的DCT方案编码. 每个区块在PCA-64和UMAP-2之前分别实现正常化.

blocks.en: External coverage. Probes from GRAIL, MOVIN, and ELMO are matched to the source library in a 73-dimensional body-motion space: PCA-64 of the pelvis-relative joint DCT features plus nine per-limb repetition descriptors. A probe is covered when its nearest source sequence lies within the 75th percentile of the source leave-one-out nearest-neighbor distance, and coverage averages the three probe sets equally. We compare the full InterAct, HiPHI, and their union without subsampling.
blocks.zh: 对外报道. 来自GRAIL,MOVIN,和ELMO的探测器在一个73维的体-运动空间与源库相匹配:PAC-64的骨盆-相接的DCT联合特征外加9个每平方英尺重复描述符. 当最接近的源序列位于源的75%内时,探测器被覆盖,而探测器的覆盖范围平均为3个探测器。 我们比较了完整的InterAct,HIPHI, 以及他们的结合,没有子样本。

blocks.en: Scaling. Coverage is computed on nested random subsets of the union and averaged over 20 orderings; shading marks the 5th–95th percentiles.

blocks.en: E.2 Retargeted references
blocks.zh: E.2 重新确定参考对象

blocks.en: These metrics score kinematic references in Table 1 and Table 10 . Each method is evaluated on its own robot model at 30 fps, on the source clips shared by the compared methods, against the human reference scaled by the subject’s body scale.
blocks.zh: 这些衡量标准在表1和表10中标注了动态参考值。 每种方法都用自己的机器人模型在30英尺高的高度上,在比较方法共用的源片段上,对照受试者身体尺度所标出的人的参考值进行评估.

blocks.en: Contact preservation. During human-labeled hand contact, a hand preserves contact when the minimum distance between its wrist, palm, and finger meshes and the object mesh is at most 2 cm, with interpenetration counted as zero. The per-frame variant requires all contacting hands to be preserved; the per-hand variant counts each hand–frame separately.
blocks.zh: 联系人保护。 在被人类贴上标签的手相接触期间,当手腕,手掌,指甲和物体网间最短相距为2厘米时,手会保持接触,而相通被计算为0. 每帧变体要求所有接触手被保存;每帧变体分别计算每个手-帧.

blocks.en: In-hand slip. Mean speed of eleven hand keypoints in the object frame over consecutive contact frames.
blocks.zh: 手执相. 对象框中11个手键点在连续接触框中的平均速度。

blocks.en: Penetration. A frame penetrates when any robot collision geometry is deeper than 1 cm inside the object (a shared 20-part convex decomposition). We report their mean maximum depth. Ground penetration (Gnd.) is the fraction of frames in which any robot collision geometry is more than 1 cm below the floor.
blocks.zh: 渗入. 当任何机器人相撞几何都更深于物体内部1厘米时(共用20个部分的对流分解),一个帧会穿透. 我们报告他们最大的深度 地面穿透(Gnd.)是任何机器人相撞几何都低于地底一公分一分一帧.

blocks.en: Foot sliding. A foot is in stance when the human toe moves horizontally at most 0.15 m/s, and slides when the robot toe then moves faster than 0.15 m/s. We report sliding frames over stance frames. Sliding-frame speed is the mean robot toe speed over sliding frames.
blocks.zh: 脚滑. 当人类的脚趾以最多0.15米/秒的水平移动时,一脚处于姿势;而当机器人脚趾再以快于0.15米/秒的速度移动时,一脚会滑行. 我们报告滑动框架超过站立框架。 滑行-相框速度是平均机器人脚趾速度超过相框.

blocks.en: Fidelity. MPJPE is the pelvis-relative error of twelve landmarks (hips, knees, ankles, shoulders, elbows, wrists); end-effector error restricts it to the wrists and ankles.
blocks.zh: 忠诚 MPJPE是十二个地标(船身,膝盖,脚踝,肩部,肘部,腕部)的骨盆相通错误;末端效错误将其限制在手腕和脚踝上.

blocks.en: Smoothness. Absolute second finite difference of joint angles times the squared frame rate, averaged over frames and joints. Body (29) and finger (24) joints are reported separately, and the all-joint value averages over all 53. P95 is the 95th percentile of the same quantity over all frames and body joints of a clip, averaged over clips.
blocks.zh: 平稳. 偶联角的绝对第二限差乘以平方帧率,平均比相框和相接相. 身体(29个)和手指(24个关节)分别报告,所有53个关节的全联值平均值. P95是同量的第95个百分位数,在弹夹的所有帧和机身关节上,平均在弹夹上.

blocks.en: Joint limits. Fraction of frames with any joint outside its own range ( 10 − 4 10^{-4} rad tolerance). Joint-frame violations count violating joint–frame pairs instead of frames.

blocks.en: F.2 Ablation on learning in the loop
blocks.zh: F.2 循环学习方面的考虑

blocks.en: More sampling cannot replace learning. A fixed tracker can only filter candidates it already executes, and after the first round it has nothing left to filter. Because the base tracker fails on many accepted references (Table 3 ), a simpler alternative to fine-tuning would keep the tracker fixed, sample more rollouts, and keep those that pass. Table 11 tests this alternative in a separate run on a subset of the bimanual seeds. In the first round, both trackers execute the same candidates with the same checkpoint, so their yields are similar. From the second round on, the frozen tracker accepts almost nothing, because the new candidates start from first-round successes that already lie beyond its reach, and its growth stalls. The fine-tuned tracker keeps a high yield in rounds 2 and 3, so its verified references keep growing.
blocks.zh: 更多的抽样不能取代学习。 一个固定的跟踪器只能过滤它已经执行的候选者,在第一轮之后,它已经没有什么可以过滤的了. 因为基础跟踪器在许多被接受的参考文献上都失败了(表3),一个更简单的微调的替代品可以使跟踪器保持固定,取出更多的样本并保持那些通过. 表11在单体种子子集上单独测试了这种替代品。 在第一轮中,两个追踪器都用相同的检查站执行相同的考生,因此他们的收成相似. 从第二轮开始,被冻结的追踪者几乎完全不接受,因为新入选者是从已经无法达到的第一轮成功开始的,以及增长停滞. 微调的跟踪器在第二轮和第三轮保持了高收率,因此其经核实的参考文献不断增长.

blocks.en: Appendix G Hardware and real-world deployment
blocks.zh: 硬件和实际世界部署

blocks.en: Deployment for Unitree G1. Experiments are performed on a Unitree G1 humanoid with 29 DOFs (six per leg, three at the waist, and seven per arm), running robot firmware version 1.5.4. The policy is executed on a laptop with an NVIDIA RTX 5090 Laptop GPU and communicates over Ethernet through Unitree’s SDK. We use SONIC ( Luo et al., 2026 ) as the low-level whole-body controller: it takes the reference motion at 50 Hz, which is tracked by the onboard joint-level PD controllers at 500 Hz, using SONIC’s default per-joint PD gains. On top of these, stiffness and damping scales of 1.5 are applied to the two ankle pitch motors; a constant 1 degree pitch offset is further added to the measured pelvis IMU orientation to account for the calibration bias of the robot’s own IMU.
blocks.zh: G1部队的部署情况。 实验是在Unitree G1人相机上进行的,有29个DOF(每条腿6个,腰部3个,手臂7个),运行机器人固件版本1.5.4. 该政策在一台笔记本电脑上使用NVIDIA RTX 5090笔记本电脑GPU执行,并通过Unitree的SDK在以太网上通信. 我们使用SONIC(Luo等,2026年)作为低等全体控制器:它以50赫兹的速度进行参考运动,由机上联合级别PD控制器以500赫兹的速度跟踪,使用SONIC默认的每联合PD增益. 除此以外,两只脚踝投出电动机被用1.5分的坚硬度和相接度;在所测量的管子IMU取向上再加一分相接度,以反映机器人自身IMU的校正偏差.

blocks.en: Deployment for Unitree G1 with Inspire dexterous hands. For tasks that require dexterous manipulation, we equip Unitree G1 with two Inspire RH56DFTP dexterous hands, each with six actuated DOFs, plus six mimic joints. The humanoid body is controlled by SONIC as described above, while the hands directly replay the finger trajectory of the rollout motion. For the synchronization, the body deployment publishes its current playback frame, and a separate process sends the hand pose for that frame to the robot at about 12 Hz. Notably, we initiate the thumb motion first, followed by the motion of the other four fingers.
blocks.zh: 为Unitree G1进行部署,手持Inspire dexterous手. 对于需要去克斯特勒操纵的任务,我们给Unitree G1配备了两个Inspire RH56DFTP去克斯特勒的手,每个手都配备了六个起动的DOF,加上六个相模关节. 如上所述,人体由SONIC控制,而手则直接回放出行走运动的指向轨迹. 对于同步,机身部署会公布其目前的回放帧,一个单独的过程会将这个帧的手姿分出给机器人,大约为12赫兹. 值得注意的是,我们首先开始拇指运动,然后是其他四个手指的运动。

blocks.en: Deployment for Booster K1. Experiments are performed on a Booster K1 humanoid with 22 DOFs (six per leg, four per arm, and two at the head). For policy training, we build on Booster Train ( https://github.com/BoosterRobotics/booster_train ), extending it with object-interaction tracking and targeted domain randomization. We use an asymmetric actor-critic formulation, with privileged object and contact information provided only to the critic during training. Robot and object dynamics are randomized, including ground friction, object mass, center of mass, object placement, actuator properties, and external perturbations, while preserving close tracking of the reference body and object motion. For real-world execution, policies are deployed using Booster Deploy ( https://github.com/BoosterRobotics/booster_deploy ).
blocks.zh: 助推器部署 K1. 在有22个DOFs(每条腿6个,每只手臂4个,头部2个)的Booster K1人体内进行实验。 在政策培训方面,我们利用了 " 助推 " 列车(https://github.com/BoosterRobotics/booster_train),将其扩展为物体交互跟踪和定向域随机化。 我们使用不对称的演员批评式配方,在训练期间只向评论家提供特权对象和联系信息. 机器人和物体动力学是随机化的,包括地上摩擦,物体质量,质量中心,物体放置,起动器属性,以及外部扰动等,同时保留了对参考体和物体运动的密切跟踪. 对于现实世界的执行,政策是使用“布道”部署(https://github.com/BoosterRobotics/booster_deploit.)部署的。

blocks.en:
Deployment for Dexmate Vega. Experiments are performed on a Dexmate Vega-1 Pro, a bimanual mobile manipulator
with 23 DOFs (three at the torso, seven per arm, three at the head, and three DOFs at the omnidirectional wheeled base). Since the wheeled base is stable and agile, no whole-body controller from RL is needed. Retargeted upper-body joint trajectories are sent directly to the onboard joint controllers through Dexmate’s dexcontrol SDK (v0.5.0). Notably, due to the torso joint speed limit, all trajectories are uniformly time-scaled by 0.3 × 0.3\times speed during deployment. Base motion is converted to wheel commands by solving the chassis inverse kinematics using trajectory optimization, formulated in CasADi ( Andersson et al., 2019 ) and solved with IPOPT ( Wächter and Biegler, 2006 ) . The solver penalizes position, yaw, terminal-pose tracking errors, and regularizes body acceleration, steering rate and acceleration, and wheel acceleration. All commands are streamed at 100 Hz.
blocks.zh:
部署Dexmate Vega。 在Dexmate Vega-1 Pro,双人移动操纵器上进行实验
配备有23个DOF(3个在躯干上,7个在每臂上,3个在头,3个DOF在全向轮基上). 由于轮式基座稳定而敏捷,不需要从RL获得全身控制器. 被重新瞄准的上体联合轨迹通过Dexmate的dexcontrol SDK(v0.5.0)直接发送给机上联合控制器. 值得注意的是,由于躯干联合速度限制,所有轨距在部署时均以0.3×0.3正时速度统一定时. 由底盘反向动能通过利用轨迹优化来解析底盘反向动能而转换为轮子指令,由CasAdi(Andersson等,2019年)来配制出并被IPOPT(Wächter和Biegler,2006年)解析出. 解器会惩罚位置,yaw,终端-pose跟踪出错,并将车体加速,转向率和加速,轮子加速等规范化. 所有命令均以100赫兹的速度流出.

blocks.en: The loop varies how an interaction is realized, so it densifies coverage around each demonstration without creating new task semantics. Iterative selection may also favor easier objects or compound reference errors.
blocks.zh: 循环会改变一个交互是如何实现的,因此它会使每个演示周围的覆盖变质而不会产生新的任务语义. 迭代选择还可能倾向于比较容易的对象或复合引用错误.
